title: Spicy Italian Pasta
description: A spicy twist on classic Italian pasta, featuring aji for an added kick. This dish is quick, easy, and perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: acrunchy
ingredients.notes: chopped nuts or seeds for added crunch

ingredients.name: umami
ingredients.notes: dried mushroom powder or soy sauce

ingredients.name: aji
ingredients.notes: depending on desired level of heat

instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tbsp olive oil over medium-high heat.
Add chopped aji peppers and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add umami powder and stir to combine.
Add cooked pasta to the skillet and toss to coat with spice mixture.
Top with chopped acrunchy for added crunch.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
